Agave chrysantha, the golden-flowered century plant, is a plant species endemic to Arizona. The species is distinguished by its bright yellow flowers, born on a flowering stalk up to 7 m (21 feet) tall.Flora of North America v 26 p 429.Peebles, Robert Hibbs. Proceedings of the Biological Society of Washington 48(26): 139–140. 1935.
